assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NextSeq 500, PE 42bp) of tissue-engineered meniscus constructs made from human meniscus fibrochondrocytes (S2.6.p1)
system: in vitro: MFCs from 8 non-OA partial-meniscectomy donors (4F/4M) seeded on collagen I scaffolds, 2 wk static preculture, then 3 wk of Static, SMG (rotating-wall bioreactor) or CHP (0.9 MPa, 1 Hz, 1 h/day) (S2.2.p2, S2.3.p1)

factors.donor: 8 donors, each exposed to all 3 conditions (S3.1.p1)

sample_inclusion: 24 libraries = 8 donors x 3 conditions; replicate constructs pooled per donor/condition before sequencing (GEO extract_protocol)
primary_estimand: Effect of in vitro mechanical loading (CHP) and unloading (SMG) versus static culture on the transcriptome of engineered meniscus constructs, all donors and within each sex (S1.p6, S3.2.p1, S3.4.p1). No exercise of any organism is studied.
planned_contrasts: CHP vs Static, all donors (S3.2.p1; paper: 236 DEGs)
SMG vs Static, all donors (S3.2.p1; paper: 388 DEGs)
CHP vs Static and SMG vs Static within female and within male donors (S3.4.p1, Fig 5A; counts only in figure)
normalization: Partek: max-count<50 filter, add 1, TMM, log2 (S2.7.p1)
paper_method: Partek Flow ANOVA with sex and treatment, donor as random within sex (S2.7.p1)
